class.name: IfcReinforcingMeshType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: A series of longitudinal and transverse wires or bars of various gauges, arranged at right angles to each other and welded at all points of intersection; usually used for concrete slab reinforcement. Also known as welded wire fabric. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x4 Material Use Definition : An associated material denotes the steel grade, preferrably via material classifi
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: The predefined type is always MESH. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The overall length of the mesh measured in its longitudinal direction. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The overall width of the mesh measured in its transversal direction. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The nominal diameter denoting the cross-section size of the longitudinal bars. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The nominal diameter denoting the cross-section size of the transverse bars. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The effective cross-section area of the longitudinal bars of the mesh. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
The effective cross-section area of the transverse bars of the mesh. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

The spacing between the longitudinal bars. Note: an even distribution of bars is presumed; other cases are handled by classification or property sets. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.

The spacing between the transverse bars. Note: an even distribution of bars is presumed; other cases are handled by classification or property sets. A float, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
An Array of values (String, float, int or bool), or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
